claims.claim_text: The NGFS v4 Net Zero 2050 scenario is applied using a top-down sector-pathway approach; carbon price assumptions are taken from the IEA Net Zero Emissions 2050 trajectory and mapped to counterparty NACE sectors; stranded asset estimates are derived from sector-level fossil fuel capital expenditure exposure; scope covers all lending book exposures across DE, FR, IT, NL and ES.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown 1.4 "Scenario analysis methodology and assumptions" (NGFS v4 Net Zero 2050 bullet)

claims.claim_text: The NGFS v4 Below 2°C (orderly) scenario is applied using NGFS integrated assessment model outputs aligned to a 1.8°C median temperature pathway, with a carbon price trajectory from the REMIND-MAgPIE model; financial impact is assessed through loan-level probability of default sensitivity to carbon cost pass-through by sector carbon intensity tier.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown 1.4 "Scenario analysis methodology and assumptions" (NGFS v4 Below 2°C bullet)
claims.support_notes: Methodology is explicitly described; no validation or model governance details provided here.
